lines.text: Three of them, amber, moving slow - and I know how that sounds, I've had eleven years to hear it all. They came together over the wheel and they made a circle. Just hung there, a ring of light, maybe a minute. And she was there too - we'd both gone to the fairground, separately, don't ask me how. She was by the ticket booth and she said: is that your idea? And I said no. And then I asked her to marry me, right there, under it.
